name: Generations
description: A loop that records itself again through a small room on every pass, so what you played slowly dissolves into the ringing tones of the room.

params.name: Length
params.description: How long the loop is, the time before what was played comes back through the room. Short loops age quickly, long ones take minutes to dissolve.

params.name: Room
params.description: The size of the room. A larger room rings on lower tones, a smaller one on higher tones, and all of its tones move together.

params.name: Resonance
params.description: How strongly the room prints its tones on each pass. Low settings dissolve the sound slowly, high settings turn it into ringing tones within a few passes.

params.name: Keep
params.description: How much of each pass is recorded again. Low settings let the loop fade quickly, and at the top the room tone hangs for as long as it is left.

params.name: Damping
params.description: The highs lost on every pass. Higher settings make each generation darker, until only the low tones of the room are left.

params.name: Hiss
params.description: Noise added on every pass, following the level of the loop. The room colours it too, so high settings turn old layers into breath on the room's tones.

params.name: Width
params.description: Tunes the room a little differently on the left and the right, so the sound spreads wider with every pass. At zero both sides share one room.

params.name: Listen
params.description: Off stops new playing from reaching the loop while what is there goes on ageing. On lets the input in again.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the loop.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The process of playing a recording back into a room and recording it again, generation after generation, as a live loop with a modelled room of eight resonances; not a model of any room, recording or machine.
